sections.heading: A Guide to Understanding U-Values: What Do Those Numbers Mean?
body: ONLINE DESIGNER
When it comes to selecting the
perfect windows
for your home, understanding U-values is paramount. U-values play a crucial role in determining the energy efficiency of windows.
But what exactly do these numbers signify, and how do they impact your choices?
Here is our expert guide to help you choose the best U-Value for your windows and help you understand what else you need to check before making any decision.

sections.heading: What Are U-Values?
body: U-values, also known as thermal transmittance, quantify the rate at which heat transfers through a material. In the context of windows, U-values indicate how much heat escapes through the window. A lower U-value indicates better insulation and, consequently, higher energy efficiency.

sections.heading: Why do U-Values Matter for Windows?
body: Windows are vital components of a building’s envelope, influencing its overall energy performance. Understanding the U-values associated with different types of windows helps in making informed decisions during construction or renovation projects.
Here’s a breakdown of U-values for windows:
Single Glazed Windows:

Traditional single glazed windows have the highest U-values among all window types. With only one pane of glass, they offer minimal insulation, resulting in significant heat loss. U-values for single glazed windows typically range from 4.0 to 6.0 W/m²K.
Double Glazed Windows:

Double glazed windows consist of two panes of glass separated by a spacer filled with either air or gas, such as argon or krypton. This configuration enhances insulation compared to single glazed windows, leading to lower U-values. U-values for double glazed windows generally range from 1.2 to 3.0 W/m²K, depending on factors like glass coatings and spacer materials.
Triple Glazed Windows:

Triple glazed windows feature three panes of glass with two insulating spaces. This design offers superior thermal performance, significantly reducing heat transfer compared to single and double glazed windows. As a result, triple glazed windows boast the lowest U-values, typically ranging from 0.8 to 1.2 W/m²K.

sections.heading: Choosing Energy-Efficient Windows
body: When selecting windows for your property, consider the climatic conditions, orientation, and energy efficiency goals. Opting for windows with lower U-values helps in reducing energy consumption, enhancing comfort, and minimising heating and cooling costs over time.

sections.heading: Conclusion
body: U-values play a pivotal role in assessing the energy efficiency of windows. By understanding U-values and their implications, homeowners can make informed choices to optimise energy performance and enhance comfort levels within buildings.
Whether it’s single, double, or triple glazed windows, prioritising lower U-values contributes to creating more sustainable and comfortable living and working environments.

But what exactly are Louvre Vents made of? Where are they used? And most importantly, how do they work?

In this article, we’ll delve into the mechanics of Louvre Air Vents and explore their diverse applications. From maintaining optimal room temperatures to controlling ventilation in specialised environments like incubators, louvres play an essential role in various settings.
Understanding their functionality and adaptability can help you determine whether they’re a fitting choice for your project.

, at Fenster, we have plenty of options for you. Aluminium door have lots of benefits, for example long lasting security measures. This includes hinges which are available colour matched to your needs and deliver a service up to 15 years. Furthermore, they are tested to a maximum of 200.000 cycles, ensuring their durability is build to last. The doors are very secure because we offer three types of multipoint locking systems as standard. These include the FLO1 KFV AS 2600 multipoint locking system as standard, alongside the FLO2 KFV AS 3600 automatic locking with day opener. You can also get the FLO3 KFV AS 3600 part motorised locking system on all fingerprint and key pad entry systems, which ensures that no intruder will break into your home.

Another benefit of our bifold doors is that they have very slim sightlines and are thermally efficient. The door glass unit comes with triple glazing, while it is laminated at 8.8mm. In addition, the glass is also 6.4mm laminated, and argon filled, so it will keep the door together against tough weather conditions. The thick glass will keep you and your home safe, while giving you exceptionally low U values of 0.6 W/m

K, helping both you and the environment. We offer different glass types which are bespoke to every customers needs. Choose from Clear, Parsol Grey, Parsol Bronze, Etched Stripes, or Satin. The choices are completely up to you.

sections.heading: Save on Space
body: Your bifold door has very slim sightlines, creating the illusion of a bigger space. Single framed doors have a 66.5 mm sightline, while a door with sidelights and toplights has a 74.5mm sightline. This will give you stunning panoramic views of your garden, while it comes with an aluminium outer frame as well. The outer frame is very slim at 88.5mm, with mechanically jointed milted corner joints, mullions, and transoms. This allows you to save on space more.

sections.heading: Contemporary Aesthetics
body: Your aluminium door brings plenty of modern aesthetics to your home. For example, there are a wide range of décor colours and finishes which can be in colour or printed using natural fibre materials (65%). As standard, we can offer wood and stone effects, leaving you with plenty of choice.

We also offer aluminium coats that come in a selection of choices. This includes a Polyester RAL smooth matte finish, with 70 microns minimum for higher durability. You can choose from satin or gloss finishes too. You can even choose our FCX (Festa colour teXtured) range, which is a structured polyester powder. There are many interior finishes and colours for you to go for, for example gray, green, and red. You can enhance your Northampton home with our wide range of choices.

sections.heading: Flexibility
body: Your biflold door is very flexible because it can create a seamless transition from room to room. You can choose which way it opens as well, because you control how many panels of natural light you want. The possibilities are infinite. sections.heading: Excellent Thermal Performance
body: Your doors are very thermally efficient because they offer very low U Values. Both the Door Glass Unit and the Side Glass Unit offer low U values of 0.6 W/m

K. The double glass unit will benefit from a 32mm black warm edge spacer, which reduces heat transfer across the centre of the glass. The side door unit also comes with a 24mm black warm edge spacer. Both of these units can help reduce your carbon footprint.

sections.heading: Multi Point Locking
body: Your bifold doors come with three multipoint locking systems that will bolster your Northampton home’s security. These include the FLO1 KVF AS 2600 multi point locking system, which is included as standard on all doors. You can also go with the FLO2 KVF AS 3600 which has an automatic locking with a day opener. Finally, we also offer a FLO3 KVF AS 3600 system on all fingerpad and entry systems.

But that’s not all, because we even offer alternative locking systems such as the Ekey dLine fingerscaner or the Ekey digital keypad, which bring modern technology to the forefront with convenient remote opening and a practical virtual assistant.

sections.heading: Weatherproof Aluminium Bifold Doors
body: Your aluminium doors are very weatherproof. This is because they are fitted with 3 Level EDPM seals in black as standard. Not only that, but you will benefit from a low threshold option that results in being airtight and watertight.

sections.heading: Uninterrupted Views
body: Your doors offer uninterrupted views because of their slim sightlines. They are able to fit large double glass panels. With slim sightlines of 66.5mm sightlines and doors with a 74.5mm sightline, you will get unobstructed panoramic views which will help you enjoy your garden for longer.

are a great choice for your aluminium bifold doors, as they allow you to control the amount of natural light that can enter your home. sections.heading: Aluminium Doors Northampton
body: Transform your Northampton home with our stunning Aluminium doors.

sections.heading: Aluminium Doors Northampton
body: At Fenster Glazing, we manufacture a wide range of aluminium doors for your Northampton home. Aluminium doors are ideal for your home because they will bring plenty of natural light, resulting in a welcoming space. The doors themselves offer benefits, including extra security protection. The doors include Livius security systems as standard, which are very strong. All of the profile cylinders are anti bump and drill protected, which will prevent the doors from being forced open. You can also take advantage of the alternative unlocking systems we offer, such as the Ekey dLine fingerscaner or the Ekey digital keypad. These systems will give you unlimited protection that meets tomorrow’s needs, so you will get keyless entry, convenient remote opening, and automatic push notifications. As a result, you can have complete peace of mind that no one will be able to break into your home. You will also get the standard FLO1 KFV AS 2600 multi point locking system, the FLO2 KFV AS 3600 automatic locking with day opener, and the FLO3 KFV AS 3600 part motorised locking on all entry systems.

The aluminium doors are customised bespoke to your needs with plenty of finishing materials for you to choose from. This includes aluminium colours such as a polyester RAL smooth coated matte finish. You can also choose from satin and gloss finishes too, which are 70 microns high for maximum durability. We also offer FCX (Festa Structured TeXtured), which is a textured polyester powder. Here, you can choose from many different colours, including blue, green, grey, red, yellow, and white. You also have the option of a stone veneer finish on some models or even some décor finishes, which have an acrylic PUR-RESIN outer skin to keep you protected against the weather. To find out more,
get in touch
with us.

sections.heading: Save on Space
body: You can save on plenty of space when it comes to our aluminium doors. This is because the door glass units are triple glazed with a 66.5 mm sightline. This will give you stunning panoramic views, along with a low threshold that allows for easy access and outstanding weather performance.

sections.heading: Contemporary Aesthetics
body: Your door will also benefit from contemporary aesthetics, which will enhance its performance. You will benefit from the door being fitted by 3 level EDPM seals in black as standard and a PU foam filled panel, which includes a 3mm internal and external skin. The side panel is 6.4mm laminated and filled with argon, which leads to low emissions and is better for the environment. The door even comes with an 88.5mm aluminium frame with mechanical corner joints, mullions, and transoms, which will enhance the profile of your door.
We also offer a selection of different glass styles at your request too, including Clear, Parasol Grey, Parasol Bronze, and Etched Stripes.

sections.heading: Flexibility
body: Your doors are very flexible as well because you can choose which direction you want them to go in. There are many different configurations to consider, including a double door with a toplight or even a single door with a toplight and two sightlights. The possibilities are infinite, so you can build your ideal door to your specifications.

sections.heading: Excellent Thermal Performance
body: Your aluminium doors are ideal for your home because the double glazing that comes with them boasts exceptionally low heat values. The door glass unit and the side glass unit both have centre pane U Values of 0.6 W/m2K, which will keep natural heat inside your home. A great benefit of these doors, are that they can provide excellent amount of sound insulation. They can reduce sounds up to 44dB. It has been tested by the Airbourne sound insulation standard, so you can enjoy plenty of privacy.

sections.heading: Multi Point Locking
body: Your doors are very secure because they are bolstered by the use of our high quality multi point locking systems. These include the FLO1 KFV AS 2600 multi point locking system as standard and the Ekey dLine finger scanner and digital keypad. Feel confident that you can keep your home much more secure. Our doors are also anti bump with pick and drill protection, which will prevent forced opening. They are fitted with anti snap and anti drill cylinders which have been rigorously tested as standard.

sections.heading: Weatherproof Aluminium Doors
body: Your Northampton home is protected and secure with our weatherproof aluminium doors. The doors include a drip bar for higher weather tightness, and all the doors are fitted with 3 level EDPM seals and a low threshold for weather tightness. These doors are also very watertight because they have an air permeability of Class 4, while the water tightness is class 5A. The low threshold option stops water from coming through.

sections.heading: Uninterrupted Views
body: Our doors has very slim sightlines, This is because the single doors have a 66.5mm sightline, while doors with sidelights and toplights have a 74.5mm sightline, which brings uninterrupted views of your garden. In addition to this, you can benefit from a polyamide thermal break, reinforced with a glass fibre and PU insulated chamber.

sections.heading: Are My Windows Energy-Efficient?
body: ONLINE DESIGNER
Energy usage has grown to become a big concern for many landlords and homeowners in the United Kingdom, especially in a post-lockdown society where saving money is critical.
Installing a smart metre is a good starting point, but among the most pragmatic things, one area you can look at to minimise energy and heat loss is your windows!

It’s projected that around 25% of all energy loss in a household happens through its windows. So, although having new windows fitted may appear like a substantial initial cost, it has the potential of saving you a small fortune over time.
But what tell-tale signs should you be looking out to understand if, or not, your windows are energy efficient or require replacement?

sections.heading: Do Your Windows Open And Shut Correctly?
body: Let’s begin with the most evident signs. If your windows are difficult and stiff to open or shut effectively, then it may be an issue that a squirt of WD40 cannot fix. If you’re having a hard time closing your windows, then the chances are, you’ll be losing a lot of energy.

Your windows can get stiff for various reasons – over time, the hinges could have rusted, changing weather over time may have resulted in the expansion of materials causing ‘sticky’ windows, or the overall house structure may have changed.

sections.heading: Can You Hear External Noise And Is Coming From Your Windows?
body: Other than single glazed windows being less energy efficient than their triple or double glazed counterparts, they also permit more noise.

Have you noticed the traffic outside more than usual, or have you been hearing your neighbour?s lawnmower when all your windows are shut? This may be an indication that better glazing, seals or acoustic glass could help.
double glazing
, or that there are gaps in the windows seals.

sections.heading: Can You Feel A Draft Through Your Windows?
body: Naturally, there are rooms in your house that will be colder compared to others. However, in the rooms where it’s especially frosty, even with the heating on, feel the windows.
If your hands feel a draft permeating through the windows, even when fully shut, then it could be an indication that either the weatherstripping or windows are damaged.

If the weatherstripping is damaged, the solution can simply be replacing the old, cracked and discoloured weatherstripping with new. If the windows are damaged, then the chances are that it is a more fundamental issue.

sections.heading: Is There Mould And Moisture Buildup Around The Windows?
body: Old windows generally age by discolouration and buildup of moisture between the panels. This ageing process occurs mostly due to older windows losing their ability to stop moisture.
The buildup of water will eventually result to mould, and when you spot your first hint of mould, that’s when your windows will need to be replaced.

sections.heading: Have Your Energy Bills Recently Increased Compared To the Same Time Last Year?
body: It’s not necessarily that your old windows are the main reason your monthly energy bills have increased. However, if any of the above factors apply to you, they’re bound to play a role.

Try to compare the energy bills you incur every month to those of your previous years or your neighbour’s bills. If your energy consumption has significantly increased, then there’s a good chance your windows play a significant role in your house’s overall inefficiency.

sections.heading: The Many Benefits Of UPVC Windows For Your Home
body: ONLINE DESIGNER

sections.heading: What Is UPVC Material
body: UPVC stands for Unplasticised Polyvinylchloride Chloride (also known as rigid PVC) and is one of the longest-lasting building materials you can find being used in windows.

sections.heading: What Are The Key Benefits Of UPVC Windows
body: UPVC windows offer a range of benefits, including excellent durability and efficient performance, with little maintenance.
This helps with keeping away the normal rotting or warping you would get with other building materials.
In the end, it’s one of the most durable and long-lasting materials you can choose.
UPVC is non-conductive
. Therefore, you don’t need to worry about the frames of your windows conducting or transferring heat.
This helps the temperature of your home maintain a more stable and consistent temperature.
UPVC is well-known for its thermal efficiency
, offering greater insulation properties than what you would get from other building materials.

sections.heading: High-Security Benefits
body: Your property’s security is essential for any window installation.
The material itself is incredibly lightweight but also has a high-level of durability, unmatched with other materials.

Furthermore, UPVC offers a lot of versatility with different types of locking mechanisms. Along with being paired with double glazed glass panels. All helping. All helping to secure your home and keeping criminals out.

While the highest security level is attained with aluminium window frame installation, uPVC frames don’t lag too far behind. Thus, every time you step foot out of your home, you will have the peace of mind knowing that you are getting a good level of protection from your windows.

sections.heading: Energy Efficiency and Insulation
body: Maintaining high-level energy efficiency should be at the forefront of your mind, especially when thinking about getting new windows fitted.
The material makeup of your window selection will dictate how energy efficient your entire home is. The insulation properties of your window frames can make a big difference.

UPVC windows are some of the best performing options you will find in the marketplace. They have incredibly valuable and effective insulation properties, which means you will be able to maximise heat retention throughout your entire home.
This will not only save you a lot of money on your home’s energy bills, but it will also help you dramatically reduce your carbon footprint.
UPVC is an extremely low conductor of heat
. This helps form a closed air system within your home to reduce any resulting heat loss, unlike using other window materials.

sections.heading: Reduced Condensation
body: Because uPVC windows have better overall insulation properties, your windowpanes will be a much warmer overall temperature that minimises condensation.

sections.heading: Low Maintenance
body: UPVC is a naturally low maintenance material
. Therefore you won’t need to do as much work to keep your windows looking good over time.
Other materials are prone to rotting or flaking when they have been subject to extreme temperatures.
You will only need regularly wipe down with soapy water to remove surface dirt or grime.

sections.heading: Durability
body: UPVC as a material is extremely durable. Your window frames will be able to stand up to the most extreme conditions and elements.
Durable windows are especially beneficial for properties located near the sea where there is high salt content.
The coating found on UPVC can provide natural protection against harmful ultraviolet exposure to stop your windows from fading or discolouring.
Wooden frames will fade in colour and rot because of the different weather elements.

sections.heading: Ventilation
body: UPVC windows are available in several different style configurations that provide various methods of ventilation.

A popular ventilation configuration is known as ’tilt and turn’ that features a two-window arrangement capable of being opened in different directions. This allows for draft-free ventilation through the windows.

When the windows are tilted inwards, hot air is allowed to escape through both the top and the sides. Whereas, completely opening the window will ventilate the entire room, useful when cleaning or getting refreshing airflow.

sections.heading: Eco-Friendly Alternative
body: With the entire population facing consistent pressure and global warming threats, property owners are looking for ways to make a difference.
With UPVC windows, you are not only getting eco-friendly windows in terms of their construction and material selection, but also with their performance.
Because of the unique structure of UPVC as a material, it can be fully recycled after it reaches the end of its lifespan.
The recycled PVC content is turned into granules through a shredding process to enable the material to be recycled up to 7 times.

Typically, you will get anywhere from 40 to 80 years out of UPVC windows. Because of this, and because they are made up of mostly recyclable materials, they make a very insignificant negative impact on the environment.
The eco-friendliness and the efficient performance of these windows have made them highly desirable among domestic and commercial property owners in today’s market.
When you are looking to replace your current windows with newly made from uPVC, ensure the fitter will recycle your old windows.

sections.heading: Weather Resistant
body: Many window materials suffer from the dramatic effects of weathering. UPVC material is so durable that you won’t experience the same normal wear and tear you would see from other materials.
While the material itself is extremely durable and capable of withstanding extreme elements, you still want to take good care of the material.

sections.heading: Soundproofing
body: UPVC material is very effective and keeping sound out, and it works very well alongside double glazed panels. The two forms an excellent barrier to external sounds.
Typically UPVC windows can reduce noise penetration by as much as 50 percent compared to traditional windows.
This makes this material the optimal choice for those looking for better soundproofing from their windows.

sections.heading: Fire Retardant
body: All frames for windows need to be made from fire-rated materials to prevent the speedy spread of fire.
UPVC is a material that is specifically required by various regulations to adhere to these safety protocols.
Other materials, such as wood, can be very easy to ignite.

sections.heading: Look And Feel With Aesthetics
body: Opting for UPVC window frames will provide great looking window aesthetics with a range of styles and colours.
You certainly don’t need to compromise in style and can help you enhance your property’s curb appeal.

sections.heading: Lower Cost With UPVC
body: UPVC is a material that comes with a lot of inherent benefits.
Believe it or not, it’s also the more affordable alternative to both wooden and aluminium frames. Therefore, you won’t have to pay extra to experience all the various benefits they come with.

sections.heading: Bow & Bay Windows Northampton
body: Open up your Northampton home with our elegant bow & bay windows. These made to measure designs can improve the security, thermal efficiency and weatherproofing of a Northampton property. Use our online design tool to get a price tailored to your home improvement project. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us directly.

sections.heading: Secure Design
body: We know security is a priority to a Northampton homeowner. Despite their expansive panes of glazing, our bow and bay windows will protect your property, loved ones and prized possessions. Our bow and bay windows are fitted with cutting edge multi point locking mechanisms are standard. These locking systems are paired with modern double glazing and hard wearing profiles, for your peace of mind.

sections.heading: Acoustic Insulation
body: Bow and bay windows could be a fantastic investment if you live near a main road, have noisy neighbours or live in a built up part of town. Our double glazed windows will offer enhanced levels of acoustic insulation, helping you maintain a peaceful and private Northampton property to work, relax or socialise.

sections.heading: A+ Thermal Efficiency
body: Help maintain a consistently comfortable Northampton home with our range of bow and bay windows. These A+ rated windows will help your building better retain warmth in the cold winter months. This may find you relying less on your central heating, which could lead to lower energy bills and a more sustainable home.

sections.heading: Low Maintenance Design
body: Our bow and bay windows are crafted using premium quality uPVC, which requires minimal maintenance to stay looking as good as new. uPVC does not weather and will not lose its shape over time. Simply wipe these profiles down with a damp cloth every now and then to maintain their fresh look.

sections.heading: Weatherproof
body: Thanks to the patented bubble gasket technology, our bow and bay windows will not suffer the negative effects of weathering. The double glazing and the continuously seals which minimised draughts and leaks. Keep your Northampton property warm and dry all year round with these uPVC windows.

sections.heading: Bow & Bay Windows Northampton
body: Bow windows are fabricated using four or five identical windows which are fitted at an angle to create an attractive, curved design. This unique shape will allow you to enjoy panoramic views of your outside space and bring more light into your Northampton home.

Bay windows are similar but have some key differences from bow windows. Bay windows consist of three windows and often extend from the property at a 25 degree angle. Because these installations protrude from a home, they can add space to relax, work or for storage.

bow and bay windows.
Get in touch for more information for more information or if you have question.

sections.heading: Add Space To Your Home
body: Bow and bay windows are a fantastic way to extend your living space. They can be adapted to any style of property and any room in a Northampton home. This space can be turned into a seating area, can be used to place a work space or just be used for storage. Adding square footage will help boost the market value of your home.

sections.heading: Perfect for Heritage Properties
body: Bow and bay windows mimic the classic look of timber joinery, with all the benefits of modern uPVC. They are the perfect installation if you want to maintain the existing charm of your building and replace wooden profiles. Our bow and bay windows replicate traditional properties with 21st century levels of thermal efficiency, security and weatherproofing.

sections.heading: Our Bow and Bay Windows Brochure
body: Read through our bow and bay windows brochure to make an informed decision on your home improvement project.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
body: We have put together a list of frequently asked questions about our prices, products and services. If we have no addressed your question, please get in touch with our team.

sections.heading: What accreditation do you have?
body: Fenster Glazing are fully accredited by FENSA, the leading government-authorised competent persons scheme for the window and door industry in the UK. This means every double glazing installation we complete – including uPVC windows, aluminium bifold doors and composite front doors – meets or exceeds Building Regulations for energy efficiency and safety.

sections.heading: What’s the best way to find prices?
body: The fastest way to get a price for your new windows and doors is through our Instant Pricing Tool online. Whether you’re looking for energy-efficient uPVC casement windows, ultra-slim aluminium bifold doors, or secure composite entrance doors, you can also speak directly to our expert sales team by phone or email for a fast, practical quote.

sections.heading: Do you provide a guarantee?
body: Yes – Fenster Glazing provides a 10-year insurance-backed guarantee on every window and door installation. Whether it’s double glazed uPVC windows, aluminium bifolding doors or replacement composite doors, our guarantee ensures long-lasting performance and total peace of mind.

sections.heading: Do you use your own installers?
body: Absolutely. All our installations are carried out by our in-house team of expert window and door fitters based in Milton Keynes. Every installer is trained to handle uPVC, aluminium and composite systems, ensuring the highest standards of workmanship, compliance, and customer satisfaction.

sections.heading: Are there any hidden fees?
body: No – at Fenster Glazing, transparency is key. The price you’re quoted includes everything: supply, delivery, and professional installation of your double glazed windows or doors. There are zero hidden charges, and all VAT is included.

sections.heading: Do you charge for a consultation?
body: Not at all. We offer free, no-obligation consultations and quotes for all our window and door products. Whether you’re looking to install energy-efficient aluminium bifold doors or upgrade to A+ rated uPVC windows, our expert team will help you explore options without any pressure.

sections.heading: What energy ratings come with your windows and doors?
body: Our range of double glazed uPVC windows, aluminium doors, and composite front doors are all designed for thermal efficiency. Many of our products reach up to an A+ energy rating, helping to reduce your heating bills and keep your home comfortable all year round.

sections.heading: Do you dispose of the old windows and doors?
body: Yes – Fenster Glazing offers a full removal and eco-friendly disposal service. We recycle all old uPVC frames, glass panels, and doors responsibly, ensuring your home improvement project is as green as possible.

sections.heading: What areas do you cover?
body: We supply and install double glazing products across Milton Keynes, Buckinghamshire, Bedfordshire, Northamptonshire, Hertfordshire, and all surrounding areas. Whether you're upgrading to triple glazing or installing composite doors, our trusted installers are local to you.

sections.heading: Do you have a showroom?
body: Yes – visit the Fenster Glazing showroom at 98 Alston Drive, Milton Keynes. Here, you can see our range of premium double glazing products in person, including aluminium bifold doors, uPVC sash windows, and composite front doors. Get advice from our expert team and explore the best styles for your home.

sections.heading: How do I book a consultation?
body: Booking a consultation with Fenster Glazing is easy. Visit our website to use our Instant Pricing tool or call our team to schedule a free site visit. We’ll assess your property, recommend the best energy-efficient glazing options, and give you a tailored quote – no obligations, just expert advice.

sections.heading: Get in Touch
body: We welcome our homeowners to get in touch with us either over the phone or by email anytime. With our expert help and advice, you could develop the perfect home improvements to suit your property's style. Talk to some of our friendly staff today!

sections.heading: Use our Quoting Engine
body: Get a bespoke quote on the product that you choose by using our online quoting tool. Whether you're after a new set of windows, a front door or our other services, you can easily get an estimate from us.
Get started now!

sections.heading: Bow and Bay Windows
body: Bow and bay windows are a great way to add extra space, natural light, and character to your home. The extended design creates a wide view and a bright, open feel, making them a stylish and practical choice for homes in Milton Keynes and beyond.

sections.heading: Secure Design
body: Whether you choose bow or bay windows, we know that they are the first line of defence against potential intruders, so security should be at the forefront of every design. Our bow and bay windows are built with the latest multi point locking mechanisms to be the best safeguard for you and your family. Rest easy knowing that you and your home are safe thanks to our secure bow and bay windows.

sections.heading: Acoustic Insulation
body: If you're tired of the non stop noise from living on a main road or a busy Milton Keynes area, then these windows could be what you need. With bow and bay windows, you'll notice the benefits of acoustic insulation, as they conveniently reduce external noise by a noticeable amount. Enjoy a more peaceful night of sleep with bow and bay windows as they reduce any unwanted background noise.

sections.heading: A+ Thermal Efficiency
body: The cost of living is permanently on the rise, with utility bills being a major component of this. Here in the UK, and especially Milton Keynes, we’re no strangers to cold weather, which can make this even worse. However, when you choose bow and bay windows, you’re choosing A+ rated windows that provide a thermally efficient performance. These double glazed uPVC windows will help keep bills as low as possible.

sections.heading: Low Maintenance Design
body: The
Liniar

profiles used for these uPVC windows are a great example of windows you can fit and forget, thanks to their hassle free performance. Our bow and bay windows are made from high grade uPVC, which doesn’t feel the effects of ageing and weathering in the same way that older materials do. Cleaning couldn’t be easier; simply wipe them with a cloth every once in a while to keep them looking great.

sections.heading: The Stylish New Barn Hotel, Coventry
body: Products Used:

sections.heading: Project Overview
body: Fenster Glazing was appointed as the commercial window company responsible for delivering a full commercial window installation package as part of a major hotel refurbishment in Coventry.

The building had been stripped back to shell condition during redevelopment, creating a blank canvas for transformation into a modern hospitality environment. Our scope included the supply and installation of 37 aluminium hotel windows alongside new commercial entrance doors, forming a key part of the building envelope upgrade.
From the outset, the project required careful logistical planning, structured sequencing and disciplined site management to ensure safe and efficient delivery.

sections.heading: The Brief
body: The objective was to install high-performance hotel windows that enhanced thermal efficiency while complementing the architectural vision of the refurbished property.
Key priorities included:
Installing 37 aluminium hotel windows to precise survey dimensions
Delivering new entrance doors as part of the façade upgrade
Maintaining programme alignment within a live construction schedule
Improving insulation and long-term operational efficiency

As an experienced commercial window company, our involvement extended beyond installation. Early coordination with the principal contractor ensured access planning, lifting strategies and sequencing were agreed well before installation began.

sections.heading: The Challenge: Shell Structure and No Internal Stairs
body: One of the most significant challenges of this commercial window installation was the building’s condition at the time of works. The hotel remained a complete shell, with no internal staircases installed when glazing commenced.
This presented two key logistical considerations:
Safe access to upper floors
Controlled lifting of large aluminium window units

With no internal stair access available, the project required the use of an industrial crane to lift glazing units safely to the first floor. Careful coordination was essential to ensure lifting operations were sequenced correctly within the wider construction programme.
Crane lifts were planned in advance, factoring in:
Site access restrictions
Ground conditions
Load calculations
Safety exclusion zones

sections.heading: The Solution
body: We supplied and installed 37 aluminium hotel windows, selected for their durability, thermal performance and suitability for hospitality environments.
Aluminium systems were specified due to their:
Structural integrity
Slim sightlines
Long service life
Low maintenance requirements
Strong thermal performance when combined with modern double glazing
Each unit was manufactured to precise measurements taken during detailed site surveys, ensuring seamless integration within the refurbished façade.
New commercial entrance doors were also installed to complete the external envelope upgrade, improving both security and visual presentation.

sections.heading: Performance Improvements
body: The upgraded hotel windows significantly improve insulation throughout key areas of the building. Modern aluminium glazing systems reduce heat transfer compared to outdated or underperforming frames, supporting better temperature stability across guest rooms and communal areas.
For hospitality environments, improved insulation directly contributes to:
Reduced energy demand
Enhanced occupant comfort
Lower operational costs
Improved long-term asset performance

sections.heading: Outcome
body: The completed installation delivers a clean, contemporary façade that complements the refurbished structure while meeting modern performance standards.

While much of our work is completed during early construction phases, it is always rewarding to see the finished result once the transformation is complete. Projects like this demonstrate how structured commercial window installation plays a critical role in both performance and presentation within hospitality refurbishments.

sections.heading: A Trusted Commercial Window Company for Hotel Projects
body: Fenster Glazing regularly supports hotel and hospitality refurbishment schemes requiring disciplined commercial window installation.
Our in-house teams manage survey, installation and compliance directly, ensuring accountability, safety and consistent workmanship throughout each project.

For developers and contractors seeking durable, high-performance hotel windows installed within complex construction environments, Fenster provides structured delivery from shell stage through to completion.

sections.heading: x19 Bespoke R9 Residence in Clotted Cream
body: We were delighted to be chosen for this project which called for an array of bespoke Windows for the Water End Barn, set in one of the most stunning corners of the Bedfordshire countryside. The property is a beautifully converted heritage building that now serves as office space for several businesses, which meant our work had to balance charm, compliance and practicality all at once.

The brief was centred around upgrading the existing units with high quality heritage windows that respected the style and age of the building. To achieve this, we designed and installed nineteen bespoke windows from the Residence 9 collection, finished in the elegant Clotted Cream colour. These premium frames were selected not just for their appearance, but also for their suitability as timber alternative windows, making them ideal for a historic structure without sacrificing performance.

Because the building is now in commercial use, the project required careful planning and attention to regulation. Our survey and fitting teams worked closely with the client to ensure everything met modern standards for commercial window installation, while still retaining the authenticity that makes Water End Barn so well loved. It is always a pleasure to install heritage building windows that look as though they have always belonged there, yet perform far better than the originals ever could.

Throughout the process, we remained focused on delivering a smooth experience for the businesses using the space. We coordinated our installation schedule to minimise disruption and ensure the new office renovation windows were fitted cleanly and efficiently. The final result is a set of beautifully crafted R9 flush casement frames that brighten the barn, improve thermal comfort and complement its rustic character perfectly.

This project is a brilliant example of how modern craftsmanship can enhance traditional architecture. If you are looking for Windows Woburn specialists who understand heritage styling, commercial requirements and bespoke manufacturing, we would be delighted to help. Whether it is bespoke windows, heritage windows or full property upgrades, our team is ready to bring your building to life.

The modern double glazed units now retain warmth far more effectively, helping to lower energy bills and keep the home comfortable all year round.

sections.heading: Bespoke Period-Style uPVC Pub Windows for The Green Man, Eversholt
body: We recently completed a bespoke pub windows project at
The Green Man

, a well known village pub and restaurant that blends traditional character with modern hospitality. This project involved upgrading both upper and ground floor windows at the front and rear of the building, delivering improved performance while carefully preserving the building’s charm.

sections.heading: A Relationship Built on Trust
body: This project was commissioned by Simon, the owner of The Green Man, who we have worked with on several successful schemes previously. Thanks to the strong working relationship built over time, including earlier projects such as
Water End Barn
, this was a comfortable and collaborative job from start to finish.

When it comes to commercial double glazing, trust, communication and consistency are just as important as product quality. That long standing relationship allowed us to move efficiently from specification through to installation, ensuring minimal disruption to the pub’s day to day operation.

sections.heading: The Brief
body: The aim was to replace ageing windows with new uPVC windows that would enhance thermal performance, reduce maintenance, and maintain a traditional appearance in keeping with the building’s character. As a busy hospitality venue, durability and long term reliability were key considerations.

The windows needed to perform as true commercial double glazing while visually reflecting traditional timber joinery, something many double glazing window companies struggle to achieve without compromise.

sections.heading: Specification and Installation
body: For this project, our team completed a full uPVC windows installation across the property, supplying and fitting:
x6 Residence R9 windows
x1 three part bay window in Residence R9
x5 white woodgrain C70 flush casement windows

All windows were fitted with black monkey tail handles and astragal bars to reinforce the traditional pub aesthetic. Each unit was mechanically jointed rather than welded, giving an authentic timber style finish that complements the building’s heritage appearance.

The installation covered both the upper and ground floors, as well as elevations to the front and rear of the pub and restaurant. Careful planning ensured the works were completed efficiently, keeping downtime and disruption to an absolute minimum.

sections.heading: Performance and Practical Benefits
body: As a commercial property, the benefits of modern uPVC windows replacement extend far beyond appearance. The new glazing significantly improves insulation and draught reduction, helping regulate internal temperatures throughout the year. This is particularly important for pubs and restaurants, where guest comfort directly impacts experience.
Low maintenance frames, secure locking systems and long lasting finishes also reduce ongoing upkeep, an essential factor for busy hospitality venues.

sections.heading: A Result That Delivers on Every Level
body: This project is a strong example of how high quality pub windows can balance heritage styling with modern performance. By combining premium products with careful installation, we delivered a solution that meets the practical demands of a commercial building while respecting its traditional character.

For businesses considering commercial double glazing or uPVC windows installation, this project demonstrates how the right specification and experienced installation can achieve lasting results without compromising on appearance.

sections.heading: Project Overview
body: Fenster Glazing was appointed to deliver replacement aluminium windows and doors as part of the redevelopment of the Kitwood Unit, the latest addition to Herts & Essex Community Hospital. The project formed part of a wider programme of healthcare construction works aimed at enhancing facilities and supporting the Trust in meeting the needs of the local community.

sections.heading: The Brief
body: A key requirement was the supply of like-for-like, colour-matched aluminium window and door systems to ensure complete visual consistency across the hospital estate. Maintaining a uniform external appearance was essential, particularly where the new Kitwood Unit interfaces with existing buildings.
Performance, durability and suitability for a healthcare environment were central to the specification, with the glazing required to meet the operational demands of a busy hospital setting.

sections.heading: Our Solution
body: Fenster Glazing supplied and installed high-quality aluminium windows and doors, carefully matched in colour and profile to the existing systems. All works were delivered by our in-house installation teams, operating in line with healthcare construction requirements, approved RAMS and site-specific safety protocols.
The installation was carefully phased to minimise disruption, ensuring patient care, staff access and hospital services remained uninterrupted throughout the works.

sections.heading: Outcome
body: The completed glazing installation provides durable, high-performance commercial glazing that integrates seamlessly with the surrounding hospital buildings. The works support the ongoing development of the Kitwood Unit and contribute to a safe, consistent and professional healthcare environment.
Fenster Glazing was proud to support the Trust on a project that strengthens essential healthcare infrastructure for the Bishop’s Stortford community.

body: As soon as you have registered you will be taken to our custom design software to design your own styles to suit your home

Casement windows offer a classic, versatile design with slim sightlines and modern thermal performance. Built for everyday comfort and long-term durability, they’re a popular choice for both traditional and contemporary homes. With a range of customisable finishes, casement windows bring style, security, and efficiency to properties across Milton Keynes and beyond.

sections.heading: Built-In Weather Protection
body: Our casement windows use advanced Liniar profiles with patented bubble gaskets, creating a continuous, welded seal around the frame. This seamless barrier blocks out draughts and moisture, ensuring your home stays warm, dry, and comfortable all year round. No maintenance worries.

sections.heading: Low Maintenance, Long-Lasting
body: Crafted from modern uPVC, our casement windows offer a sleek, durable finish that won’t warp, rot, or flake over time. Unlike older window styles, they require virtually no upkeep, a simple wipe with a cloth is all it takes to keep them looking their best.

sections.heading: Enhanced Energy Efficiency
body: The slim sightlines of our casement windows not only provide a modern, sleek aesthetic but also optimise energy efficiency. With more glass area, these windows maximise natural light while improving thermal performance, helping to keep your home warmer in winter and cooler in summer, all while reducing energy costs.

sections.heading: Sustainable from Start to Finish
body: At Fenster Glazing, we prioritise sustainability without compromising on quality. That’s why we use Liniar profiles that are 100% lead-free and fully recyclable. Our casement windows are designed with environmental responsibility in mind, ensuring a safer product today and a cleaner future tomorrow.

sections.heading: Tailored to Your Style
body: With a range of profile options, including sculptured and chamfered designs, our casement windows can be customised to match your home’s unique character. Using advanced CAD software, we’ll help you bring your vision to life, ensuring your new windows perfectly complement your aesthetic.

sections.heading: uPVC Casement Windows Milton Keynes & Buckinghamshire
body: Renowned for their practicality and beautifully simple design, casement windows remain one of the UK’s favourite window styles. With an almost endless range of layouts and options, our casement windows are a stylish, cost effective choice that provide exceptional energy efficiency.
Expertly constructed using a revolutionary multi-chambered uPVC profile, our casement windows are designed to deliver outstanding performance, all the while adding a splash of style to any home in
Dunstable
Luton
, Milton Keynes, Buckinghamshire or surrounding areas.
Have a question about our best-selling casement windows?
Get in touch
today to learn more.

sections.heading: Continuously Sealed
body: Using the
Liniar

EnergyPlus profile, our casement windows feature bubble gaskets throughout their profile. Welded to the frame, they create a continuous seal inside of the double glazed window, which helps to reduce draughts as well as keeping the window completely weathertight. You’ll be able to enjoy a weatherproof and thermally efficient performance from our uPVC casement windows.

sections.heading: uPVC Profile
body: Being constructed from modern uPVC materials, our casement windows are designed to deliver an excellent performance while also being inherently stylish. Unlike antiquated styles of double glazing, you won’t have to worry about excessive maintenance and cleaning. Instead, as little as a quick wipe of the cloth could have your windows looking their absolute best without any hassle or strenuous effort.

sections.heading: Slim Sightlines
body: uPVC casement windows are an elegant and sleek style of double glazing that could transform the look of your home. By having slim sightlines, these uPVC windows make the most of the glass area to provide an appealing aesthetic. It also allows for the best panoramic views while simultaneously letting natural light flow into your Milton Keynes or further afield home, making space seem even larger than it really is as well as warm and inviting.

sections.heading: Environmentally Friendly Design
body: Fenster Glazing are dedicated to producing the best quality casement windows while also limiting our environmental impact. We work with likeminded suppliers, such as
Liniar

, to ensure that this is achieved. Our windows are 100% lead free which is much better for the environment and also makes for safer disposal. They’re also completely recyclable, able to be reused at the end of their life.

sections.heading: Style to Suit You
body: There are limitless stylistic options for you to choose from for your casement windows, helping to fit with your specific decorative style. Choose between sculptured or chamfered profiles for your uPVC windows, depending on which aesthetic you wish to achieve. Combined with our CAD software, you’ll be able to design windows that achieve your perfect vision for your new home improvements.

sections.heading: Thermally Efficient Casement Windows
body: If you’re looking to make your Milton Keynes or further afield home more energy efficient, uPVC double glazing could make a big impact. Our uPVC casement windows are renowned for their market leading thermal performance, helping to trap heat within the home in winter and stop your property from becoming too hot in summer. As an added benefit, you will have less reliance on your heating, resulting in lower utility bills.
Get Casement Windows Pricing

sections.heading: Long Lasting, Durable, uPVC Windows
body: When upgrading to our uPVC casement windows, you’re ensuring a long lasting upgrade for your Milton Keynes or further afield home. uPVC is incredibly durable and resistant, offering high resistance against the effects of ageing and weathering. With our exceptional double glazing, you could receive 30 years or more of high performance. Enjoy peace of mind knowing you have windows that are built to last with Fenster Glazing.
Casement Windows Quote

sections.heading: Our Casement Windows Brochure
body: Flick through our casement windows brochure to see all the options and additional information about our uPVC windows today!
Online Design

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
body: Take a look at some of the questions previous customers have asked regarding our casement windows. If there’s something we haven’t covered, contact us online or over the phone to talk to our expert team today.

sections.heading: What accreditation do you have?
body: Fenster Glazing are fully accredited by FENSA, the leading government-authorised competent persons scheme for the window and door industry in the UK. This means every double glazing installation we complete – including uPVC windows, aluminium bifold doors and composite front doors – meets or exceeds Building Regulations for energy efficiency and safety.

sections.heading: What’s the best way to find prices?
body: The fastest way to get a price for your new windows and doors is through our Instant Pricing Tool online. Whether you’re looking for energy-efficient uPVC casement windows, ultra-slim aluminium bifold doors, or secure composite entrance doors, you can also speak directly to our expert sales team by phone or email for a fast, practical quote.

sections.heading: Do you provide a guarantee?
body: Yes – Fenster Glazing provides a 10-year insurance-backed guarantee on every window and door installation. Whether it’s double glazed uPVC windows, aluminium bifolding doors or replacement composite doors, our guarantee ensures long-lasting performance and total peace of mind.

sections.heading: Do you use your own installers?
body: Absolutely. All our installations are carried out by our in-house team of expert window and door fitters based in Milton Keynes. Every installer is trained to handle uPVC, aluminium and composite systems, ensuring the highest standards of workmanship, compliance, and customer satisfaction.

sections.heading: Are there any hidden fees?
body: No – at Fenster Glazing, transparency is key. The price you’re quoted includes everything: supply, delivery, and professional installation of your double glazed windows or doors. There are zero hidden charges, and all VAT is included.

sections.heading: Do you charge for a consultation?
body: Not at all. We offer free, no-obligation consultations and quotes for all our window and door products. Whether you’re looking to install energy-efficient aluminium bifold doors or upgrade to A+ rated uPVC windows, our expert team will help you explore options without any pressure.

sections.heading: What energy ratings come with your windows and doors?
body: Our range of double glazed uPVC windows, aluminium doors, and composite front doors are all designed for thermal efficiency. Many of our products reach up to an A+ energy rating, helping to reduce your heating bills and keep your home comfortable all year round.

sections.heading: Do you dispose of the old windows and doors?
body: Yes – Fenster Glazing offers a full removal and eco-friendly disposal service. We recycle all old uPVC frames, glass panels, and doors responsibly, ensuring your home improvement project is as green as possible.

sections.heading: What areas do you cover?
body: We supply and install double glazing products across Milton Keynes, Buckinghamshire, Bedfordshire, Northamptonshire, Hertfordshire, and all surrounding areas. Whether you're upgrading to triple glazing or installing composite doors, our trusted installers are local to you.

sections.heading: Do you have a showroom?
body: Yes – visit the Fenster Glazing showroom at 98 Alston Drive, Milton Keynes. Here, you can see our range of premium double glazing products in person, including aluminium bifold doors, uPVC sash windows, and composite front doors. Get advice from our expert team and explore the best styles for your home.

sections.heading: How do I book a consultation?
body: Booking a consultation with Fenster Glazing is easy. Visit our website to use our Instant Pricing tool or call our team to schedule a free site visit. We’ll assess your property, recommend the best energy-efficient glazing options, and give you a tailored quote – no obligations, just expert advice.

sections.heading: Need Cat and Dog Flaps?
body: Looking to install a dog flap in your door or glass? At Fenster Glazing, we supply and install high-quality dog and cat flaps into uPVC doors, composite doors, and double glazed units. Whether you need a simple flap or a secure microchip system, our team handles everything from survey to installation.
Get a Cat/Dog Flap Quote

uPVC doors are one of the most common choices for installing cat and dog flaps thanks to their practical panelled design. This allows us to fit the flap neatly into the lower section without affecting the structure or security. We carry out precise cutting and ensure a fully weatherproof seal to prevent draughts and leaks. The result is a clean, professional finish that blends seamlessly with your existing door. uPVC installations are typically the most straightforward and cost-effective option for homeowners.

Aluminium doors require a more specialist approach when installing cat and dog flaps due to their strength and slimmer profiles. In many cases, we install the flap into a suitable panel or replace part of the door with a custom solution to ensure a secure fit. Our team takes care to maintain the door’s structural integrity, security, and thermal performance throughout. Every installation is completed with precision and sealed properly to prevent draughts or water ingress. The result is a clean, durable finish that works seamlessly with your aluminium door.

sections.heading: Conservatory glass panels
body: Conservatory glass panels are a popular place to install cat and dog flaps, particularly when leading to the garden. We use made-to-measure glass units with precision-cut openings to ensure a perfect fit. This method maintains the strength and insulation of the glass while providing a neat, unobtrusive finish. Installing a flap in a conservatory allows your pet easy access outside without altering your main doors, offering a convenient and practical solution.

sections.heading: Glass doors and sealed units
body: Installing cat and dog flaps into glass requires a specialist approach. We never cut into existing double glazed units, as this would damage the glass and reduce insulation. Instead, we supply a brand new sealed unit with a factory-cut opening designed for your chosen flap. This ensures the strength and thermal performance of the glass is maintained. We then replace the pane with the new unit, giving you a seamless, secure installation that looks and performs exactly as it should.

sections.heading: Patio and Sliding Doors
body: Patio and sliding doors are ideal for cat and dog flaps, especially for easy garden access. We install flaps into the glass panels by replacing them with custom-made units that include a pre-cut opening. This ensures a perfect fit without affecting the sliding function of the door. We also maintain the door’s security and insulation. The result is a practical solution that allows your pet to move freely while keeping your home energy efficient and secure.

sections.heading: Choosing The Right Colour For Your Front Door
body: ONLINE DESIGNER
Choosing the best front door colour will make your house look unique and stand out from the rest of the homes within your street.
Furthermore, Choosing the front door colour that suits your personality can complement your home.
We know how difficult it is to choose your front door colour. Therefore we have provided this article to help you.

sections.heading: Choose A Colour That Makes You Happy
body: Don’t choose a colour that is the same as every other house down your street. With so many front door colours to choose from, you can select a colour that makes you feel happy every time you return to your home, especially after hard workdays.
Be outrageous and playful with bright colours to catch people’s attention as they drive past your house.

Take a moment to think about your taste. Are there any colours in your home that would complement the colour of your front door? What’s your favourite colour? It sounds crazy to paint your front door your favourite colour, but depending on the colour of the inside of your home, it’s a great way to complement your home’s colour scheme.

sections.heading: Green
body: The colour green tells people that you are conscious about nature and the ecosystem and is very traditional. It’s also a colour that relates to natural surroundings instead of making such a bold statement.

sections.heading: Orange
body: Orange may seem brighter for some people, but it’s a popular choice as it provides warmth and is very inviting into the home.
Many restaurants choose the colour orange as psychologically it can make you feel hungry, so if you prefer orange for your front door, be sure to stock up with food.

sections.heading: Grey
body: Grey can be a bit on the drab side for some people, but it’s becoming a popular colour choice for the front door.
Grey provides sophistication, a touch reserved but very stylish.

sections.heading: White

sections.heading: Choosing The Right Front Door For Your Home
body: ONLINE DESIGNER

When somebody looks at your home, one of the first things they see, and generally comments on, is your front door. Your front door style provides a great impression of your home and your personality with a custom-designed door.
Choosing the right front door sets the standards for security, energy efficiency, noise and light levels throughout your home.

sections.heading: Designing A Custom Front Door
body: When designing your new front door to your home, there are several choices, whether the door provides a contrast to the rest of the house or complements the general style throughout the property.
Today, there are many choices available in the door material, fixtures and fittings, glazing, door colour and design, all providing an important part.
If you have doubt about the type of front door design for your home, design your front door to complement the current property style.
Contrasting your front door design with the rest of your home can look fantastic carried out in a fairly subtle way.
If you’re struggling with the general design, work with an experienced front door company with good design service and advice to produce the perfect design for your home.

sections.heading: Tidy Up The Front Door Entrance
body: Don’t just replace the front door, but ensure that your homes front door entrance provides the same impression as the front door itself, whether that’s inside or outside.
Within your porch area, you may be able to move the front door forward to create more space inside your home with a bigger hallway.
Take a drive around and look at some of the front doors within your neighbourhood and the local area.

Take a note of the doors that are appealing and look fantastic that’s fitted to a house that is similar in design to yours. If you’re feeling cheeky, knock on the front door and ask the residents a few questions about their front door, design, and decision-making process.

sections.heading: Choosing The Best Front Door Material
body: When you start looking around, you will realise the different colours and materials available to choose from.
UPVC and composite doors provide the most extensive options, with many benefits, such as low maintenance, high security, and extremely energy efficiency.
If you’re looking for an authentic wood look but with minimal maintenance, look for composite doors.
Composite doors are highly customisable and provide the benefits of both a UPVC door and a solid wood door.

Solid wood doors have a great look and feel when they’re first installed and are very traditional, but they are high maintenance. They don’t compare insecurity or energy efficiency against UPVC or composite doors.
Wooden doors need to be painted or varnished periodically to keep them maintained, and over time they can be susceptible to change in shape, increasing drafts and sticking.

sections.heading: Add Glazing To Your Door
body: Adding glass panels to your front door design can significantly change your front entrance’s look and feel both inside and out.
From the outside, glass panels provide a warmer feel and look more inviting, while from the inside, they offer more light into the property.
There are many different types and styles of glass panels, whether patterned, frosted or tinted, in a double glazed or triple-glazed structure.
Ensure that your front door and glass panels adhere to the latest British standards, including thermal efficiency, security and safety characteristics.
Choosing the right glass panels for your front door provides a unique look and feel to your property.

sections.heading: Fixtures And Fittings
body: There are many different types of fixtures and fittings available to add to your new front door, depending on the design you choose
Whether that’s different styles and sizes of door knobs and knockers, a letterbox installed within the door, outside the door or to the side of the door, draught strips, hinges and locks.

sections.heading: Improve Your Home Security
body: As door technology and construction have evolved over several years, security has advanced, where a good quality new front door can significantly improve your home’s security.
Ensure that your new front door includes multipoint deadlocks and meets at the very least the British standards PAS24 and that the locks conform to British standard 3621.
If you choose not to include glass in your front door, you can add a spy hole to see whose at your front door before opening it.

sections.heading: Energy And Thermal Efficiency – Keeping The Heat In
body: A good quality front door that is well fitted will significantly help to keep the heat in your house and save you money, as advised by FENSA, along with reducing any outside noise into the home.
Doors need to meet specific performance standards set out by the U.K.’s government’s commitment to improve energy efficiency.
With a thermally efficient door, your home will feel cooler in the summer but well insulated and warmer in the winter.

sections.heading: What Is The Cost Of A New Front Door?
body: It’s important that you treat the new front door’s cost as an investment for your home, and over time you will see a significant return on your investment.

You do get what you pay for, therefore a cheap front door will use lower quality materials, manufacturing techniques and installation, which will significantly affect the performance, security and longevity over time.
To understand all the benefits of a good quality front door, speak to an expert door installer to fully understand your investment costs.

sections.heading: Do I Get A Guarantee With My New Front Door
body: When selecting your front door installer, ensure you receive a ten-year guarantee.
Also, ensure you carry out your due diligence on the installer to ensure they have good reviews and testimonials and good customer service to quickly and efficiently resolve any issues.

sections.heading: Making The Final Decision To Buy Your Front Door
body: Before you make your final decision, talk to a number of door installers and door companies to get the design and quality right for your home.

sections.heading: Commercial Automation
body: Fenster Glazing introduces a suite of cutting-edge solutions designed to enhance convenience, comfort, and sustainability within commercial environments.

sections.heading: Teleflex Automation: Redefining Window Control
body: At the forefront of our offerings lies the integration of Teleflex automation technology, a game-changer when it comes to remote window operation.
Teleflex, once a brand name synonymous with advanced window control systems, has now become a generic term encompassing a range of gadgets facilitating remote window operation.
Here at Fenster Glazing, we are harnessing the power of Teleflex automation to empower commercial spaces with unparalleled convenience and functionality.

Remote manual window openers, a hallmark of Teleflex technology, offer a seamless solution for controlling windows from a distance. Gone are the days of struggling to reach windows in high-rise buildings or cumbersome commercial structures! With a simple twist of a handle at a low level, users can effortlessly open or close windows, thanks to a sophisticated system of cogs, chains, and twisted cables.

sections.heading: Customised Solutions
body: Recognising the diverse needs of commercial clients, Fenster Glazing offers tailored solutions to suit specific requirements. Whether it’s a retrofit project or new construction, our expert team collaborates closely with clients to design and implement Teleflex automation systems that seamlessly integrate with existing infrastructure.

sections.heading: Seamless Integration with Smart Building Systems
body: Fenster Glazing’s Teleflex automation seamlessly integrates with smart building management systems, enabling centralised control and optimisation of various building functions. By harmonising these systems, businesses can achieve greater synergy in their commercial spaces, resulting in enhanced comfort, productivity, and cost savings.

sections.heading: Safety and Security
body: In addition to convenience, we prioritise safety and security. Teleflex automation allows for centralised control of windows, mitigating risks associated with manual operation in high-traffic areas or hazardous environments. Moreover, advanced features such as automated locking mechanisms provide an extra layer of security, safeguarding commercial assets and personnel.

sections.heading: Step into the Future with Our Cutting-Edge Automated Doors
body: We specialise in providing state-of-the-art automated door solutions tailored to elevate the accessibility and functionality of commercial spaces. Our automated door systems offer unparalleled convenience, seamlessly integrating with your building’s infrastructure to provide smooth and efficient entry and exit experiences.
With our highly-functional automated doors, you can ensure hassle-free access for employees, customers and visitors while maintaining the highest standards of security and convenience.

sections.heading: Automatic Window Openers / Actuators
body: At Fenster Glazing, we understand the importance of seamless automation in commercial settings. That's why we offer top-of-the-line automatic window openers and actuators designed to enhance both convenience and efficiency.
Our automatic window solutions provide unparalleled ease of use, allowing windows to open and close automatically based on preset parameters or environmental conditions.

sections.heading: Electric Strike Options
body: In addition to our advanced window automation solutions, we also provide electric strike options for automatic opening doors. These electric strikes enable doors to be opened automatically, enhancing accessibility and streamlining entry points within your commercial space.
Trust Fenster Glazing to deliver cutting-edge automation solutions tailored to meet the unique needs of your commercial environment!

body: Our staff, based in Milton Keynes, welcome questions from our clients. To make the process easier, we have compiled a list of the most common questions. If you still need more information, feel free to get in touch with us online or over the phone.

sections.heading: What accreditation do you have?
body: Fenster Glazing are fully accredited by FENSA, the leading government-authorised competent persons scheme for the window and door industry in the UK. This means every double glazing installation we complete – including uPVC windows, aluminium bifold doors and composite front doors – meets or exceeds Building Regulations for energy efficiency and safety.

sections.heading: Do you provide a guarantee?
body: Yes – Fenster Glazing provides a 10-year insurance-backed guarantee on every window and door installation. Whether it’s double glazed uPVC windows, aluminium bifolding doors or replacement composite doors, our guarantee ensures long-lasting performance and total peace of mind.

sections.heading: Do you use your own installers?
body: Absolutely. All our installations are carried out by our in-house team of expert window and door fitters based in Milton Keynes. Every installer is trained to handle uPVC, aluminium and composite systems, ensuring the highest standards of workmanship, compliance, and customer satisfaction.

sections.heading: Are there any hidden fees?
body: No – at Fenster Glazing, transparency is key. The price you’re quoted includes everything: supply, delivery, and professional installation of your double glazed windows or doors. There are zero hidden charges, and all VAT is included.

sections.heading: Do you charge for a consultation?
body: Not at all. We offer free, no-obligation consultations and quotes for all our window and door products. Whether you’re looking to install energy-efficient aluminium bifold doors or upgrade to A+ rated uPVC windows, our expert team will help you explore options without any pressure.

sections.heading: What energy ratings come with your windows and doors?
body: Our range of double glazed uPVC windows, aluminium doors, and composite front doors are all designed for thermal efficiency. Many of our products reach up to an A+ energy rating, helping to reduce your heating bills and keep your home comfortable all year round.

sections.heading: Do you dispose of the old windows and doors?
body: Yes – Fenster Glazing offers a full removal and eco-friendly disposal service. We recycle all old uPVC frames, glass panels, and doors responsibly, ensuring your home improvement project is as green as possible.

sections.heading: What areas do you cover?
body: We supply and install double glazing products across Milton Keynes, Buckinghamshire, Bedfordshire, Northamptonshire, Hertfordshire, and all surrounding areas. Whether you're upgrading to triple glazing or installing composite doors, our trusted installers are local to you.

Here, you can see our range of premium double glazing products in person, including aluminium bifold doors, uPVC sash windows, and composite front doors. Get advice from our expert team and explore the best styles for your home.

sections.heading: Delivering Glazing Within Live Commercial Environments
body: Refurbishment in Bedfordshire often takes place in operational buildings. Schools remain open. Clinics continue treating patients. Offices maintain occupancy.

A useful analogy is infrastructure maintenance on an active motorway. Work must be carefully phased, access controlled and disruption minimised while the system continues to function.
In Bedfordshire commercial settings, this means:
Phased installation aligned to term breaks or shutdown windows
Strict safeguarding protocols in education environments
Controlled access and site zoning
Noise and dust management procedures
Clear coordination with principal contractors
Our teams plan glazing sequences in advance, integrating installation into scaffold schedules, roofing works and internal refurbishment phases.
